zonefile_dir.description: Directory where zone files are stored. Must be writable by knot user.

log_file.description: Optional path to KNOT log file. Leave empty to use system logging (e.g., systemd-journald or syslog).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the KNOT daemon.

identity.description: Server identity string used in logs and responses. Should be a short hostname or identifier.

workers.description: Number of worker threads. 0 means auto-detect based on CPU cores. Minimum 1 if explicitly set.

max_concurrent_queries.description: Maximum concurrent queries per worker thread. 0 means use KNOT's internal default.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open files (ulimit). 0 means use system default limit.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. Choose from: critical, error, warning, notice, info, debug.

id.description: Unique identifier for this server instance (used internally).

listen.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4, :: for all IPv6).

port.description: Port number to listen on (standard DNS port: 53).

interface.description: Optional network interface name to bind to (e.g., eth0). If omitted, uses all interfaces matching 'listen'.

servers.description: List of network endpoints (interfaces/ports/protocols) KNOT will listen on.

address.description: CIDR list of allowed/denied addresses (comma-separated, e.g., 192.168.0.0/16, 10.0.0.0/8).

log.description: If true, log rejected requests matching this ACL.

acls.description: Access control lists to govern which clients can query or transfer zones.

file.description: Zone file path relative to zonefile-dir (e.g., example.com.zone). Required for master zones.

notify.description: If true, send AXFR notifies to configured masters/secondaries.

masters.description: Comma-separated list of master server IPs for slave zones (e.g., '192.0.2.1,192.0.2.2').

journal.description: If true, use journal file for zone changes (required for incremental zone transfers).

dnssec.description: If true, enable DNSSEC for this zone.

zones.description: List of zones managed by this KNOT instance. At least one zone is required.

id.description: Policy identifier (used in zone config via key-policy: <id>).

size.description: Key size in bits (0 means use default for algorithm; e.g., 2048 for RSASHA256).

ttl.description: TTL for DNSKEY and DS records in seconds.

lifetime.description: Key validity period in seconds (0 = no automatic rollover).

replay_protection.description: If true, enable replay protection for DNSKEY RRSIGs.

key_policies.description: DNSSEC key policies used for automatic key management. Required only for signed zones.

id.description: Remote identifier (used in ACLs, zone masters, etc.).

remotes.description: List of remote servers (e.g., for forwarding, master/secondary relations, or recursion).
